title: Cartwise+ Annual Members and the Weight Tolerance on Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Weight tolerance for Cartwise+ annual members

Member benefit note, Cartwise+ Membership, as it applies to lines sold by weight on Cartwise Grocery Orders. The weight tolerance on such a line sets its overage allowance, which is the requested weight multiplied by one plus the weight tolerance percentage divided by 100. The weight tolerance depends on the Cartwise+ membership recorded on the order.

## Benefit clause

- When that membership is on an annual plan and was enrolled at least 24 whole calendar months before the order's placed date, the weight tolerance is 0 percent, so the overage allowance is the requested weight itself.
- When it is on an annual plan and was enrolled at least 12 and fewer than 24 whole calendar months before the order's placed date, the weight tolerance is 5 percent.
- In any other case — a monthly plan whatever its tenure, an annual plan enrolled fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the placed date, or an order with no Cartwise+ membership recorded — the membership does not alter the weight tolerance.

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date. Here the earlier date is the membership's enrolled date in the Cartwise+ Membership records and the later date is the placed date of the order.

## Records read

- The Cartwise+ membership recorded on the order at checkout, its plan and that plan's billing cycle (monthly or annual).
- The membership's enrolled date.
- The order's placed date.

## Tenure table

| Plan billing cycle | Whole months from enrolled date to placed date | Weight tolerance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Annual | 24 or more | 0 percent |
| Annual | 12 to 23 | 5 percent |
| Annual | 11 or fewer | not altered by the membership |
| Monthly | any | not altered by the membership |
| No membership recorded | — | not altered by the membership |

## Anniversary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Annual plan enrolled on 15 March; order placed on 14 March two years later. The 24th anniversary (15 March) falls after the placed date, so 23 whole months have passed: tolerance 5 percent.
- Same membership; order placed on 15 March two years later. The 24th anniversary falls on the placed date: 24 whole months, tolerance 0 percent.
- Annual plan enrolled on 15 March; order placed on 14 March of the following year: 11 whole months, the membership does not alter the tolerance.

## Worked allowance (hypothetical inputs)

A requested weight of 2.00 pounds gives an overage allowance of 2.00 pounds at a tolerance of 0 percent, and of 2.10 pounds (2.00 multiplied by 1.05) at a tolerance of 5 percent.
